The format change is in and `tests/test_format.py` passes, but I wouldn't call the task done yet. The full `make check` has one failure, and I haven't confirmed that my change didn't cause it.

No file edits are planned. Here is what I would run, in order.

**1. Confirm the new test failed before my change.** I don't have a red run on record, so I'd check now by stashing only the production change:

<command>git stash push -- tides/format.py && uv run pytest -q tests/test_format.py; git stash pop</command>

I expect the new rounding test to fail on the old code with a wrong-value assertion, not an error. If it passes without my change, the test doesn't prove anything and I'd rewrite it.

**2. Check whether `test_offline_cache_refill` fails without my change.** I'd stash both files and run it with the project's flag:

<command>git stash push -- tides/format.py tests/test_format.py && uv run pytest -q --golden tests/test_sync.py::test_offline_cache_refill; git stash pop</command>

- **It fails the same way (`41 == 48`):** the failure predates my work. I'd leave it alone and report it.
- **It passes on the stashed tree:** my rounding change broke it, probably because the sync code compares or dedups on heights. I'd write a failing test for that interaction before touching any code.

**3. Run the lint step.** `make check` runs `ruff check .` only after pytest succeeds, so it never ran:

<command>ruff check .</command>

**4. Re-run the full suite.**

<command>make check</command>

**Message to my partner (to send after those runs, with the bracketed parts filled in from what I see):**

> Task 3 is implemented: `tides/format.py` now rounds predicted heights to 0.01 m. I confirmed the new test in `tests/test_format.py` fails without the change and passes with it, and all 6 tests in that file pass.
>
> I ran the documented suite, `make check` (`pytest --golden tests/`). Result: 63 passed, 1 skipped, **1 failed**.
> - **Failed:** `tests/test_sync.py::test_offline_cache_refill` (`assert 41 == 48`). [With my change stashed, this test fails identically / passes, so it is pre-existing / caused by my change.] [If pre-existing: I haven't touched it. Do you want me to investigate it separately?]
> - **Skipped:** `tests/test_stations.py:44`, which needs `TIDE_LIVE=1`. I haven't run the live tests.
> - **Lint:** `ruff check .` [result]. `make check` stops at the pytest failure, so I ran ruff on its own.
